 A powerful magnitude-7 earthquake struck China’s Tibet region, killing at least 16 people, injuring dozens and forcing more than 12,000 residents from their homes as hundreds of aftershocks rattled the area.More than 300 homes were reported damaged or destroyed, while thousands of rescuers, police and soldiers were deployed amid freezing temperatures.
